descriptionHtml:
Luxury you can hang.

Made from premium scotch-embossed cow leather, printed in unique designs that elevate each piece into a statement. The leather’s texture isn’t just pretty: it’s scratch-resistant and made to last.

Paired with 18-carat gold-plated hardware, our charms make holding your sunnies a little extra chic. Choose from 18 designs.

seo.title: Lun’elle sunglasses holder, printed leather | Elle.ay
seo.description: Lun’elle: a sunglasses holder in printed scotch-embossed cow leather with 18-carat gold-plated hardware, in 18 designs.
